title: Real-content CSR expired carbon monoxide listing extraction schema
description: Extract listing metadata and every expired-CO measurement row from a clinical study report appendix listing. Rows are grouped by subject: the subject number and study product are printed only on the first row of each group and must be carried forward to its continuation rows. '---' cells mean not measured (null); times 'ND'/'UNK' are kept as printed per the page note.

cro_study_number.description: CRO study number from the page header, e.g. '7694-105'.

sponsor_protocol_number.description: Sponsor protocol number from the page header, e.g. 'SM 08-01'.

listing_number.description: Listing number from the title line, e.g. '16.2.6-1'.

listing_title.description: Listing title text, e.g. 'Expired Carbon Monoxide by Subject'.

study_population.description: Population named on the 'Study Population:' line.

note_line.description: The page-bottom NOTE line explaining ND/UNK codes.

measurements.description: Every measurement row in document order (one per timepoint).

subject_number.description: Subject identifier, e.g. 'R1001'; printed only on the first row of the subject's group — carry forward.

study_product.description: Study product; printed only on the group's first row — carry forward.

eco_ppm.description: ECO level in ppm; '---' prints as null.

source_page.description: Page number as printed on the page of the row. This document's printed page numbering is offset from the PDF page index; report the number printed on the page, not the PDF page position.
